mentions.name: Handcrafted twin baby rattles
mentions.description: This is a handcrafted pair of wooden baby rattles made as a gift for a friend expecting twins. Built with low-tech woodworking techniques on a lathe — no screens, no CNC — the project focuses on shaping two forms with organic curves and precise cuts as close to identical or mirror-image as possible while hiding the joints.
mentions.problem: The challenge of producing two handcrafted rattles with organic curves and precise cuts that are as close to identical or mirror-image as possible while hiding the joints.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm using some new woodworking techniques to make a pair of baby rattles for her. The real challenge is trying to make two shapes with organic curves and precise cuts that are as close to identical or mirror-image as possible, while also hiding the joints.
